title: The greatest boxer you've never heard of
description:
Rocky Marciano went 49-0 with 43 knockouts and remains the only world heavyweight champion in history to retire undefeated - and stay retired. At 5'10" with one of the shortest reaches of any heavyweight champ, he gave away size in almost every fight.
In his 1952 title bout he was knocked down in the first round and losing on points, then knocked out Jersey Joe Walcott with a single overhand right in the 13th.
